name: Pork Chop
siboNotes: Plain pork chop is excellent for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides easily digestible protein. Avoid marinades or seasonings containing garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Marinate in low-FODMAP ingredients like lemon juice and olive oil
Cook thoroughly but avoid overcooking to maintain digestibility
nutritionalHighlights: High in complete protein (25-30g per serving)
Excellent source of B vitamins, especially B12 and thiamine
Good source of zinc and niacin
